items.title: Stanley Black & Decker earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Stanley Black & Decker (SWK) reported Q3 on Nov 4, 2026. Adjusted EPS was $2.31 against a $1.56 estimate, a 48.1% surprise. Revenue of $3.73B matched consensus. The stock reacted more strongly than the pre-market move suggested. It was at $120.36 (+15.04%) at 12:26 PM EST, after a pre-market print of $108.65 at 9:24 AM EST. That puts it at a new 52-week high of $122.68 intraday, up about 60% year to date.
